nodes.label: XMSS: eXtended Merkle Signature Scheme (IETF RFC 8391)
nodes.description: Stateful hash-based digital signature scheme providing post-quantum security based on minimal security assumptions on collision-resistant cryptographic hash functions.

nodes.label: Compute Express Link (CXL) 3.1 Fabric Manager Management API (FM-API)
nodes.description: Out-of-band and in-band management interface protocol for orchestrating CXL multi-tier fabrics, memory pooling, and dynamic capacity allocation across multi-tenant clusters.

nodes.label: QALM Dialectal and Modern Standard Arabic Morpho-Syntactic Disambiguator
nodes.description: Specialized Arabic language representation model tailored for morpho-syntactic disambiguation, contextual POS tagging, and root-based semantic graph indexing.

nodes.label: W3C RDF-Star and SPARQL-Star Extension Standard
nodes.description: Extension to the RDF data model and SPARQL query language enabling statements about statements (embedded triples) with lightweight statement-level metadata annotation.

nodes.label: GraphBLAS Algebraic Bellman-Ford Shortest Path Algorithm
nodes.description: Single-source shortest path algorithm executed via matrix-vector multiplications over the Min-Plus (tropical) semiring in GraphBLAS algebra.
